text:
hema: FYI rolled the AWQ-int8 profile to the dedicated Mixtral pool last night and we're seeing a 9-15% p95 increase for long-context requests. Attaching quick perf dump below.

chris: Oof. Is this limited to Mixtral-8B or across models?

hema: Mostly Mixtral so far. Quick checks on Mistral-7B and Qwen14B look fine but I've only sampled a few traces.

perf-bot: perf summary:
```
model: mixtral-8B-awq-int8
workload: long-context chat (avg seq 1024)
p95_before: 78ms
p95_after: 92ms
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.83 -> 0.68
batch_size_avg: 3.4 -> 2.9
kernel_selected: matmul_v2_awq_opt -> fallback_gen_mm
obs: kernel fallback occurs at seq>768 for some batches
```

yoav: Two quick hypotheses: 1) KV cache prefetch warmup changed (evictions up) 2) kernel selector heuristics started preferring a safer path for AWQ when head-dim % 64 != 0.

marta: I noticed a recent change in selector heuristics (commit a1bb3ceb) that adds a penalty if quant blocksize mismatch suspected. Could be triggering fallback for certain head/kv dims.

chris: If the kernel falls back to generic mm it would explain the p95 hit. But why the hit-rate drop on KV? Are we evicting more aggressively under the new batching policy?

hema: Batching heuristics were tightened to avoid oversized microbatches for dedicated pools (commit b4c2f1). That reduces average batch size slightly. Perf log suggests more frequent KV churn because microbatch boundaries align poorly with our prefix caching logic.

yoav: Can you paste a trace sample?

hema: Trace (abridged):
```
[trace id=tx-9f2]
seq_len: 1200
kernel_path: matmul_v2_awq_opt -> fallback_gen_mm
kv_prefetch: hit
kv_evict: true (last_access 11m)
batch_id: 48231 (microbatch=1, global_batch=4)
cpu->gpu memcpy (ms): 2.4
mm_kernel (ms): 25.8 -> 42.1 (fallback)
```

marta: That mm delta is consistent with fallback. Also kv_evict:true while kv_prefetch:hit seems contradictory — prefetched prefix but later evicted when continuation arrived. Could be a bug in our KV LRU under high microbatch churn.

yoav: Action plan: bisect kernel selector change + reproduce locally with long-context replay. If selector is the trigger we can tighten the conditions or add head-dim-aware override.

chris: Also run AWQ calibration prompts and eval the accuracy delta if we consider switching quant kernels. Last time we saw AWQ->GPTQ differences on a few instruction-following prompts.

hema: I kicked off a targeted bench run: `python infra/bench/replay.py --model mixtral-8b --quant awq --seq 1200 --batch 4 --replay-id long-chat-042`

perf-bot: bench job queued (id=bench-773). Estimated runtime ~18m.

marta: I'll start a bisect on commit range `a1bb3ceb..b4c2f1` for selector and batching flags. If it's the selector we can a) revert the penalty, or b) add a whitelist for head-dim multiples we observed for Mixtral.

yoav: If KV eviction rate is the root cause we should consider increasing the prefetch window for dedicated pools (prefetch +2 segments) and/or relaxing microbatch flush thresholds. Small config change with low risk.

chris: For mitigation, recommend a canary rollback of the AWQ profile on the affected pool while we root-cause. Rolling AWQ back to last-known-good should restore kernel path and p95.

hema: Agreed. I'll submit a canary rollback to dedicated-mixtral and pin quant config while we investigate.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback started for pool `dedicated-mixtral` at ts=2623459000 (operator=hema). Monitoring p95.

perf-bot: bench job completed (bench-773). Quick summary: p95 reverted to 80ms when using previous AWQ config; KV hit-rate back to 0.82. Full logs uploaded to /mnt/logs/bench-773.tar.gz

marta: Good. After rollback let's run a controlled experiment toggling only the selector penalty to confirm. If confirmed, we can refine selector logic to be quant-aware by model family instead of blanket penalty.

yoav: Also add a quick unit test for KV LRU under microbatch churn — caught similar flakiness in the past.

hema: I'll open a tracking ticket with artifacts and assign bisect + kv test to eng-runtime.

chris: Thanks all. Quick checklist: 1) bisect selector (marta) 2) kv LRU unit test + bench (yoav) 3) AWQ rollback pinned (hema) 4) follow-up canary once selector fix ready. :thumbsup:

marta: I'll post bisect findings in this thread.

hema: Updated ticket: https://redwood/intern/issue/RT-enc-412 (contains trace + bench archives)

deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed for `dedicated-mixtral` at ts=2623459788. p95 trending down at 2623460000. :white_check_mark:
